blocks.text: The Philippines’ back-to-back Miss Grand International titleholders Christine Juliane “CJ” Opiaza and Emma Tiglao will once again share the pageant stage in Bangkok, Thailand, as they are set to host the “Grand Final” of MGI All Stars Season 2. Opiaza hosted the welcome ceremony of the inaugural edition held in May in Bangkok, while Tiglao hosted the preliminary and final competitions. Now they are returning with fellow Miss Grand International titleholders. Joining the two Filipino pageant queens are 2023 winner Luciana Fuster from Peru and reigning queen Jihan Dimack from Tanzania. Opiaza and Tiglao also joined the Peruvian beauty as hosts […]...
